## IntegerHelpers.truncate() method

Drop the fractional part of `value` (round toward zero: `2.9` → `2`<!-- -->, `-2.9` → `-2`<!-- -->), then validate it. The result is never `-0`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
truncate(value: number): Integer;
```

## Exceptions

`RangeError` when `value` is not finite or the truncated value is outside [INTEGER_LIMITS](./contracts.integer_limits.md)<!-- -->. `TypeError` when `value` is not a number.
